governingBehaviorContract.signedBy: pending exact owner act over the PWB truth-and-readiness amendment manifest

phaseA.derivedSeedRule: after the root index is admitted, read only the README index named for each declared pillar root; use Git tree metadata, not bodies, to enumerate baseline openspec/specs/*/spec.md paths and top-level roster/*/butler.toml candidates
phaseA.output: revision-bound source manifest with extraction classes and sha256 digest

phaseB.manifestRule: manifest must validate against the signed PWB source grammar; it is derived data, not a separate owner-approved artifact

sourceAdmission.pathRuleScope: apply basename and prefix rules to the final segment, and suffix rules to the complete final segment, of each normalized repository-relative path

activeContentClassification.inertContextRule: markup-like bytes wholly inside a syntactically closed inline code span or fenced code block do not by themselves match an active-content form; they remain untrusted text, are scanned by every secret detector before parsing, and are context-encoded at every sink
activeContentClassification.renderRule: admitted Markdown is never rendered as HTML; selected text is encoded for its destination and code-context bytes never mint a link, element, attribute, script or handler

unclassifiableExclusion.appliesTo: every artifact excluded by classificationOrder step 6 for a reason other than a detector or active-content match: NUL byte, strict UTF-8 failure, malformed code context, unknown extraction class, parse failure or resource-limit failure

redactionClasses.vocabulary: closed by RFC5-17: excluded-artifact, redacted-span, unclassifiable-excluded
redactionClasses.unknownRendering: both emitted classes withhold the whole artifact, so every claim that depended on it renders Unknown with reason excluded-content and the exclusion count shown

classificationOrder: verify exact Git-object membership in the phase-A seed algorithm or the phase-B revision-bound manifest against the signed PWB grammar
reject denied path or unsupported encoding
run every detector over transient bytes before parsing
classify active content with Markdown code-context awareness; exclude a genuine active form and fail closed on malformed code context
parse only the closed extraction class assigned by the manifest
exclude the whole artifact on any match, NUL byte, strict UTF-8 failure, unknown extraction class, parse failure or resource-limit failure
classificationSuccess: a body is classifiable only when its normalized path is admitted by its current discovery phase, it decodes as strict UTF-8 without NUL, no detector matches anywhere in the complete body including inert code contexts, no active-content form occurs outside a valid inert code context, its extraction class is in the signed PWB closed set, and that extractor completes within declared deterministic limits
